what: Post hoc reading check of the pattern-based utility score (protocol A20)
scope: all 144 utility answers of the frozen test run: 24 questions x 2 scripts x 3 arms (unsteered, pooled, residualized)
method: Every answer was read in full by the LLM agent on 2026-11-12. This is not human annotation and not by a native speaker, and the arm of each answer was visible. The answer patterns were fixed before the run and were NOT changed; the pre-registered utility numbers are unchanged.
rule: An answer is correct on reading if it states the right answer to the question, in either script or as an English gloss (the patterns accept English too). A wrong or absent stated answer is incorrect even if the right value appears later in the text.

disagreements.reason: names the gas as 'oksijen (O2)'; the patterns cover 'oxygen' and the Urdu-script word only
names the ocean with the Urdu-script transliteration of 'Pacific'; the patterns cover the Urdu name 'Bahr-ul-Kahil' and Latin 'pacific'. The residualized answer adds '(Pacific Ocean)' and is matched
states 13 as the number of things in a dozen, then says a dozen is usually used to count 12 things; the pattern matched the later 12. The unsteered answer also states 13 and is scored incorrect

agreeing_but_worth_knowing.u13-ro: all arms: an invented Roman-Urdu word followed by the gloss '(heart)'; correct through the English gloss
agreeing_but_worth_knowing.u04-ur: all arms: a meaningless Urdu name followed by '(Jupiter)'; correct through the English gloss
